facts.text: ExtractWorld_v1 is constructed with extraction='water_oil_2' and target_material='Na'
ExtractWorldEnv takes dt=0.01 s and stores it as the environment timestep; the ExtractWorld_v1 subclass does not override it
reset() takes no seed argument, rebuilds the extraction vessels and returns the state
step() returns (state, reward, done, {}) and decrements n_steps, setting done when the counter reaches zero
After each step the state is regenerated by util.generate_state over the extraction vessels
The action space is MultiDiscrete([self.n_actions, 5]): an operation selector plus a five-value multiplier
The multiplier is action[1] divided by 4, and 0 when action[1] is 0
action[0] routes to the nine operations documented by get_action_space: valve, three mixes, four transfers and done (8)
done_reward is -100 when the second beaker holds no target material and otherwise 100 times the amount collected over the initial amount

determinism.notes: ExtractWorldEnv.reset() accepts no seed and rebuilds a fixed vessel setup, so the seed that cap.world.reset.v1 echoes labels the episode but does not change the initial state; the same actions from a fresh reset repeat exactly

gaps: the fake models the action interface and a simple mass transfer, not the chemistry: the vessel event queue, phase separation, spectra and thermodynamics of the upstream extraction are not implemented

the upstream environment declares no observation_space (the assignment is commented out at extractworld_v1_engine.py:40); the fake returns a compact three-vessel state (three 4x10 material matrices, 4x4 solute matrices and 5-value layer vectors) instead of the upstream state (three total_num_material x 10 material matrices, total_num_material x total_num_material solute matrices and 100-pixel layer vectors; material.py defines 26 direct Material subclasses at this commit), so observation sizes differ from the real environment
the fake ignores the reset seed, matching the upstream reset() signature, so cap.world.reset.v1's seed only labels the episode
no rendering: the fake does not implement render() or human_render(), and cap.world.render.v1 is not bound
no physical device is modelled and the fake was never compared with a run of the upstream environment

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
